message.content:
Here’s a quick‑look at the long weekends that Canadians enjoyed in **2023** (based on the federal statutory holidays that apply nationwide).  
(Provincial holidays such as Family Day, Civic Holiday, etc., will shift the exact dates for residents in those provinces.)

| Long Weekend | Holiday(s) | Dates (2023) | Notes |
|--------------|------------|--------------|-------|
| **New Year’s** | New Year’s Day (observed) | **Jan 1 – Jan 3** | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday; it was observed on Monday, Jan 2. |
| **Family Day** (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba) | Family Day | **Feb 18 – Feb 20** | Family Day is always on the third Monday of February. |
| **Good Friday** | Good Friday | **Apr 7 – Apr 9** | Good Friday is a statutory holiday in all provinces. |
| **Victoria Day** | Victoria Day | **May 20 – May 22** | Celebrated on the last Monday before May 25. |
| **Canada Day** | Canada Day (observed) | **Jul 1 – Jul 3** | Canada Day fell on Saturday; it was observed on Monday, Jul 3. |
| **Labour Day** | Labour Day | **Sep 2 – Sep 4** | First Monday in September. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Thanksgiving | **Oct 7 – Oct 9** | Second Monday in October. |
| **Remembrance Day** | Remembrance Day | **Nov 10 – Nov 12** | Observed on Thursday, Nov 11; creates a short long weekend. |
| **Christmas** | Christmas Day | **Dec 23 – Dec 25** | Christmas Day fell on Monday. |
| **Boxing Day** | Boxing Day | **Dec 24 – Dec 26** | Observed on Tuesday, Dec 26; creates a long weekend. |

### Quick Summary (by month)

- **January:** Jan 1–3 (New Year’s)  
- **February:** Feb 18–20 (Family Day – Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba)  
- **April:** Apr 7–9 (Good Friday)  
- **May:** May 20–22 (Victoria Day)  
- **July:** Jul 1–3 (Canada Day – observed)  
- **September:** Sep 2–4 (Labour Day)  
- **October:** Oct 7–9 (Thanksgiving)  
- **November:** Nov 10–12 (Remembrance Day – short long weekend)  
- **December:** Dec 23–25 (Christmas) & Dec 24–26 (Boxing Day)

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning app! If you need province‑specific long weekends (e.g., Civic Holiday in British Columbia, St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.), let me know and I can add those too.
